problem_analysis.contract_order: Construction records precede proposition entries and therefore create forward references to future entry identifiers.
problem_analysis.current_constraint_behavior: The DFA records construction host and return identifiers, but inherited entry-type, scope-relation, and host choices remain independent of those commitments while entries are emitted.
problem_analysis.late_detection: The declared construction mapping is checked only when coverage is projected or terminal graph validation runs.
problem_analysis.observed_failure: The model declared MIXED_CREATIVE_AND_REAL_WORLD with P1 as host and P2 as return, then emitted P1 and P2 as standalone REAL_WORLD_COMMITMENT entries. No P1 creative host existed, so coverage had no legal continuation.
problem_analysis.repetition: Both authorized deterministic runs reached byte-identical 2911-byte partial output and the same COVERAGE liveness failure.
problem_analysis.root_cause: A structurally binding forward declaration is represented as retrospective validation rather than as an obligation projected into later constrained choices.
not_root_cause: A need to force every candidate into a creative construction
Absence of a Case 01-specific mechanism or expected answer in the prompt

secondary_latent_findings.finding: The partial candidate_span contains spelling variation relative to the immutable candidate.
secondary_latent_findings.boundary: Exact source-membership validation was never reached; this may become a later failure but must not be silently repaired or folded into the current causal class.

secondary_latent_findings.finding: The partial commitments appear to import detailed authority facts rather than neutralize only candidate-carried propositions.
secondary_latent_findings.boundary: Preserve as a future evaluation concern. Do not expand this remediation into source-role or semantic-correctness repair.

remediation_candidate.name: STAGE_P_CONSTRUCTION_OBLIGATION_PROJECTION_V1
remediation_candidate.scope: A separately versioned evaluation-only DFA/contract-coherence layer. Prompt semantics and schema field order remain unchanged unless later zero-inference feasibility proves a minimal clarification necessary.

derived_obligations.creative_host_ids: Every creative_host_entry_id from MATERIAL_CREATIVE_OR_EDITORIAL or MIXED_CREATIVE_AND_REAL_WORLD records maps to required entry type CONTAINED_CREATIVE and required scope relation CREATIVE_HOST.
derived_obligations.mixed_return_ids: Every literal_or_return_entry_id from a MIXED record maps to required entry type REAL_WORLD_COMMITMENT, required scope relation FACTUAL_RETURN_WITHIN_CREATIVE_HOST, and the exact host declared by that record.
derived_obligations.literal_entry_ids: Every linked identifier from a LITERAL_ONLY record maps to REAL_WORLD_COMMITMENT with a non-creative standalone relation unless another valid construction record gives it a stricter compatible role.
derived_obligations.unresolved_requirement: UNRESOLVED_CONSTRUCTION_ROLE requires at least one UNRESOLVED_SCOPE entry and INDETERMINATE coverage, without prescribing its identifier or wording.
derived_obligations.unbound_ids: Entry identifiers not referenced by construction records retain the existing role-coherent choice space.

projection_points.rule: Compile immutable host, return, literal, and unresolved obligations before the first proposition entry is emitted. Reject conflicting obligations immediately.
Exclude already-emitted identifiers and retain flexible entry order. A referenced identifier remains available until its obligation is discharged.

Condition choices on the selected identifier: declared hosts can only be CONTAINED_CREATIVE; declared returns/literal entries can only be REAL_WORLD_COMMITMENT; unbound identifiers retain existing choices.
Condition declared hosts to CREATIVE_HOST, mixed returns to FACTUAL_RETURN_WITHIN_CREATIVE_HOST, and literal-only links to their compatible non-creative relation.
For a declared mixed return, emit only the exact host identifier from its construction record.

Do not permit closing the entry array while any required host/return/literal obligation is missing or while an unresolved construction lacks an unresolved entry. Representation exhaustion fails closed with a specific obligation-liveness receipt.
Retain full retrospective graph validation as defense-in-depth; it must no longer be the first point at which construction commitments affect legal output.

conflict_rules: One identifier cannot be both a creative host and a real-world return/literal entry.
One return identifier cannot point to two different hosts.
A material construction cannot omit its host obligation.
A mixed construction cannot omit all return obligations.
Duplicate construction records may share a host only when their role obligations are compatible.
Any unresolved or unrepresentable conflict fails closed before entry emission.
remediation_candidate.semantic_boundary: Projection enforces coherence of identifiers and roles already chosen by the model. It does not decide whether a span is genuinely creative, whether a real-world proposition is supported, or whether the chosen segmentation is owner-correct.
remediation_candidate.freedom_boundary: No lexical cue, entity, mechanism, Case 01 wording, expected label, fixed entry count, or fixed segmentation selects a creative path. The model may choose NO_MATERIAL_CREATIVE_CONSTRUCTION, material, mixed, rhetorical-color, or unresolved according to the candidate.
remediation_candidate.literal_path: NO_MATERIAL_CREATIVE_CONSTRUCTION remains a first-class valid path. It creates no creative-host obligation and can complete with literal real-world entries and empty creative-target audits.
remediation_candidate.fail_closed_boundary: Conflicts, missing required entries, representation limits, unresolved roles, and malformed forward references cannot be converted into COMPLETE by omission.

paired_zero_inference_fixtures: Literal-only record with linked P1 permits P1 REAL_WORLD_COMMITMENT and no creative host.
Material record declaring P1 host forces P1 CONTAINED_CREATIVE plus CREATIVE_HOST.
Mixed record declaring P1 host and P2 return forces the exact P1/P2 role-relation-host tuple.
The repeated invalid Case 01-shaped P1/P2 tuple becomes impossible before coverage.
Entry order P2 then P1 remains valid when forward host reference is coherently discharged before collection close.
Missing declared P1 or P2 prevents entry-array closure.
Conflicting host/return use of P1 fails before entry emission.
Two compatible records may share one creative host.
Unbound entries retain existing legal role choices.
Unresolved construction requires an unresolved entry and INDETERMINATE coverage.
regressions: All existing Construction Role contract and source-membership fixtures remain valid unless they encode a previously accepted incoherent forward mapping.
The frozen Case 01 run receipts and partial bytes remain unchanged.
Receipt-propagation V1.1 remains independently valid and unchanged.
Literal candidates are not forced to emit creative hosts or target audits.
No source-span spelling repair, semantic adjudication, or authority-fact import is performed by this layer.

rejected_options.option: Keep retrospective validation only and rerun
rejected_options.reason: Two byte-identical deterministic failures demonstrate that another unchanged call has negligible diagnostic value.
This would permit construction records to claim hosts that do not exist and recreate false-complete behavior.

rejected_options.option: Force P1 to be creative for Case 01 by prompt wording
rejected_options.reason: Case-specific expected outcomes and lexical routing are prohibited and would not generalize.

rejected_options.option: Require at least one creative host in every ledger
rejected_options.reason: This destroys the legitimate literal and abstaining paths.

rejected_options.option: Silently rewrite construction identifiers after generation
rejected_options.reason: Repair or selection would erase raw model behavior and weaken auditability.

rejected_options.option: Bundle source-span and authority-import repair now
rejected_options.reason: Those are latent, independently adjudicable failures not causally necessary to resolve the observed reconciliation liveness failure.
